title: terminal: include wide char wrapped onto next page when copying selection
body:
Copying a selection whose end lands on the spacer head before a wrapped wide character (for example an emoji at the right edge) dropped that character when the wrapped row started a new page.

`PageFormatter` only handled the move onto the next row within a page and left a TODO for the cross-page case. Move the handling into `PageListFormatter`, which can advance the end pin across pages, and drop the in-page code: search, the only other `PageFormatter` user, always formats whole pages, so nothing relied on it.

Testing note (this confused me): The shell line editor (at least for zsh) can interfere with creating a spacer head before a wrapped wide character, so best to output wide characters directly to the terminal outside of the shell line editor.

AI disclosure: Created with gpt-6 astra using codex. Reviewed and modified by me.
